title: Enforcing Tail Calibration When Training Probabilistic Forecast Models
improvement: GSE adds a tail-weighted CRPS term to the probabilistic training loss and a TMCB diagnostic to the weekly calibration report, fixing blowout-tail miscalibration without degrading already-calibrated components.
gate: ADOPT twCRPS training term if the fine-tune experiment improves TMCB skill >=30% at t=10 with CRPS skill change >=-1% on the holdout season; if TMCB penalty alone is needed, accept only with overall MCB degradation <=20%.

title: Statistical post-processing of operational dual-resolution wind-speed ensemble forecasts
improvement: GSE builds an EMOS post-processing layer for stadium wind: truncated-normal EMOS with affine links on ensemble mean/spread fit per stadium on trailing 60-day windows, feeding the predictive distribution into the conformal weather layer.
gate: ADOPT if local/semi-local EMOS beats raw by >=5% CRPSS on wind speed at 0-3d leads on the 2023-2024 holdout; REJECT if gain <5% and rely on the ANET2 wind flow instead.

title: T-SHRED: Symbolic Regression for Regularization and Model Discovery with Transformer Shallow Recurrent Decoders
improvement: GSE builds GameSHRED: a transformer encoder with SINDy-Attention heads over lag-8 weekly team 'sensor' vectors that reads out stable, human-readable ODEs of team-state dynamics while matching the neural forecaster's spread MAE.
gate: ADOPT if GameSHRED's spread MAE is within 0.5 points of the engine's neural forecaster on 2025 AND >=2 heads yield stable human-readable ODEs AND total model size <100 MB; REJECT if MAE trails by >1.0 point.

title: Optimal Online Bookmaking for Any Number of Outcomes
improvement: GSE builds an adversarial-exposure diagnostic using closed-form online-bookmaking loss bounds, separating realized pick losses that fall inside the minimax envelope (adversarial flow) from losses that breach it (model misspecification).
gate: ADAPT confirmed if the closed-form envelopes compute cleanly on GSE data and the diagnostic separates within-envelope from model-error losses on at least 80% of game-weeks; REJECT if the envelope is vacuous (>3x the realized range).

title: Personnel-adjustment for home run park effects in Major League Baseball
improvement: GSE separates stadium effects from roster quality with a personnel-adjusted GLMM on points/FG makes, producing Denver-altitude-style adjusted stadium factors for the totals model and kicker props.
gate: ADAPT the elsewhere-covariate method if OOS totals RMSE improves >=0.3 points over raw venue means and >=3 stadiums move >=5 rank places between raw and adjusted scoring-friendliness.

title: Arnoldi Singular Vector perturbations for machine learning weather prediction
improvement: GSE generates probabilistic game-day weather from the Pangu Weather 24h model perturbed by Arnoldi singular vectors (K~16 members, zero-mean pairs), extracting a stadium ensemble distribution rather than a point forecast.
gate: ADAPT if ensemble spread shows positive spread-skill correlation on hold-out games and tail-wind detection beats the deterministic baseline on totals residuals; otherwise keep only deterministic Pangu.

title: PETSA: Parameter-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting
improvement: GSE freezes the main win-prob model after preseason and updates only a tiny weekly overlay (64 per-team adjustment terms + 2-3 global calibration parameters) on the prior week's games with Huber-robust loss.
gate: ADOPT if on 2020-2025 walk-forward the overlay beats the frozen model on anytime Brier by >=0.002 with ECE neutral-or-better AND captures >=80% of the full-refit gain.

title: HiT-JEPA: A Hierarchical Self-supervised Trajectory Embedding Framework for Similarity Computation
improvement: GSE encodes 10Hz NGS tracking plays into hierarchical self-supervised trajectory embeddings (per-player sequences pooled by permutation-invariant attention) as retrieval and feature inputs for the matchup model.
gate: ADOPT if EITHER top-1 same-play-concept retrieval accuracy >=40% on held-out weeks 13-18 2024 (vs <=15% random, >=10pp above raw-DTW) OR downstream log-loss improves >=0.002 vs the no-embedding baseline.

title: Scope Meets Screen: Lessons Learned in Designing Composite Visualizations for Marksmanship Training Across Skill Levels
improvement: GSE hardens its analytics-visual doctrine: every visual breakdown stays video-anchored (real footage base layer with analytics overlaid, never a detached chart), built in novice and expert versions per the two-version rule.
gate: Accept as evidence for visualization design guidance only (preference + perceived understanding, honestly caveated); gate any GSE build on the reproducible test — do not redesign without it.

title: USAD: End-to-End Human Activity Recognition via Diffusion Model with Spatiotemporal Attention
improvement: GSE ports statistics-guided diffusion augmentation for rare NFL events (broken-tackle runs, coverage busts): per-play kinematic stats condition a label-conditioned DDPM that generates class-balanced synthetic plays to pretrain the event classifier.
gate: Accept as evidence that statistics-guided diffusion augmentation + adaptive composite loss improves imbalanced time-series classification; port only the augmentation recipe and composite loss, skipping the network.

title: Enhancing Sports Strategy with Video Analytics and Data Mining: Assessing the effectiveness of Multimodal LLMs in tennis video analysis
improvement: GSE builds film-analysis content tooling as a hybrid CV-to-text-to-LLM pipeline: cheap per-frame detectors convert footage to compact text (trajectories, ball positions, formation labels) for LLM narration and tactical Q&A, never MLLM-first video.
gate: PURSUE only if structured-feature prompting beats raw-frame prompting by >=25pp on event-sequence edit score on the 50-play window AND matches a cheap heuristic baseline.

title: Enhancing Sports Strategy with Video Analytics and Data Mining: Automated Video-Based Analytics Framework for Tennis Doubles
improvement: GSE builds a 'Labelling Factory' for proprietary charting-equivalent labels from footage (pre-snap OL splits, DB technique, pressure-path geometry) on a forked CVAT with NFL label schema, prototyping features before buying.
gate: ADOPT if the transfer-learned CNN reaches macro AUC >=0.80 for personnel/formation classification on the held-out game AND annotation throughput is >=2x the unaided manual rate; otherwise keep buying charting.

title: ConBatch-BAL: Batch Bayesian Active Learning under Budget Constraints
improvement: GSE allocates its weekly charting/labeling budget with ConBatch-BAL: a dollar-capped acquisition rule that admits games by cost-per-slot and scores them with BADGE/BatchBALD, beating cost-blind top-k.
gate: ADOPT the better of the two rules iff it beats cost-blind top-k at equal weekly dollar budget by >=0.005 held-out log-loss on the 2024 season simulation AND does not collapse in any single week (no week >2x average per-dollar regret).

title: Temporal Conformal Prediction (TCP): A Distribution-Free Framework for Adaptive Risk Forecasting
improvement: GSE wraps game-total intervals in temporal conformal prediction: rolling quantile models with a windowed conformal threshold and a Robbins-Monro update on weekly coverage errors, keeping rolling coverage within 2pp of nominal.
gate: ADOPT the RM adaptive layer if it keeps rolling coverage within 2pp of nominal over the 2025 season with width <= static conformal; REJECT the shrink heuristic if it causes systematic under-coverage; require an ACI baseline.

title: Beating the Best Constant Rebalancing Portfolio in Long-Term Investment: A Generalization of the Kelly Criterion and Universal Learning Algorithm for Markets with Serial Dependence
improvement: GSE allocates bankroll across concurrent picks with periodic Kelly-style allocation: partition bet history into k=7 day-of-week or situational buckets, each learning its own allocation via the k-PUP update tuned to that bucket's return profile.
gate: ADAPT if on walk-forward (k chosen on 2023, evaluated 2024-2025) the k-PUP bankroll multiple exceeds flat fractional-Kelly by >=10% with max drawdown no worse than 1.2x the baseline's.

title: A Bayesian circular mixed-effects model for explaining variability in directional movement in American football
improvement: GSE extracts a per-season 'shiftiness' feature for RBs/WRs from von Mises mixed-effects models of ball-carrier movement on tracking data, predicting next-season YAC and missed-tackle rate.
gate: ADOPT if adding the shiftiness feature improves out-of-sample prediction of next-season YAC/attempt or missed-tackle rate over the current RB/WR feature set by >=0.02 R^2 (or significant at alpha=0.05); REJECT if no stable year-over-year signal.

title: Mallows Model with Learned Distance Metrics: Sampling and Maximum Likelihood Estimation
improvement: GSE aggregates weekly NFL power rankings from ~15-20 public and market-implied sources with an L_alpha-Mallows model, learning the league's upset-profile parameter alpha as a first-class feature.
gate: Adopt L_alpha-Mallows if on the 2025 held-out season it beats both baselines by >=2pp on pairwise accuracy AND >=5pp on top-5 hit rate in at least 3 of 4 seasons rolling; REJECT if alpha estimates are unstable.

title: Are Betting Markets Better than Polling in Predicting Political Elections?
improvement: GSE classifies line moves as steam vs noise with a BSTS local-level model on de-vigged market-implied probability series: high tau^2/sigma^2 ratio means informed persistent moves, low means public churn.
gate: ADAPT-accept iff informed-steam-flagged moves achieve mean CLV >=+1.5% (de-vigged) vs <=+0.3% for unflagged moves over the 2023-2024 test set with n>=200 flagged moves.

title: Linear Acceleration Is a Primary Risk Factor for Concussion
improvement: GSE builds a per-play concussion-probability model for injury reporting and player-availability adjustments: univariate/bivariate logistic risk functions on impact kinematics with BIC+LASSO selection, publishing NFL-specific 50% risk thresholds.
gate: ADAPT the risk-function methodology if the replication confirms linear acceleration in the top-2 predictors by AUPRC with a 50% threshold of 60-140 g; REJECT the helmet-tech claim entirely (conflicted source, not prediction).

title: THYME: Temporal Hierarchical-Cyclic Interactivity Modeling for Video Scene Graphs in Aerial Footage
improvement: GSE builds an NGS interaction-graph builder per play: 22 tracked players as graph nodes, hierarchical aggregation player->unit->formation via attention, plus cyclic temporal attention over the play's frame sequence by play phase.
gate: Accept as evidence that hierarchical + cyclic temporal modeling improves scene-graph recall; gate the GSE port on the reproducible test — only build after the pattern reproduces on NFL data.

title: Player-Team Heterogeneous Interaction Graph Transformer for Soccer Outcome Prediction
improvement: GSE reimplements the player-team heterogeneous interaction graph transformer on NFL data: 22-starter nodes with typed edges (pass, rush, target, pressure, coverage) plus head-to-head team edges, fusing GCN, heterogeneous transformer, and MoE gating.
gate: ADAPT if the NFL reimplementation beats nfelo by >=1.5pp accuracy on the time-ordered 2024 holdout AND its ECE <= Elo's after temperature scaling; reject otherwise.

title: Posture-Driven Action Intent Inference for Playing Style and Fatigue Assessment
improvement: GSE derives effort/intensity labels from NGS tracking with a motion-range model: per-play speed range, lateral displacement range, and direction-change count feeding a random forest for high-effort vs routine plays.
gate: Accept as evidence that kinematic time-series intent classification works (~0.78 F1 / 0.87 AUC under honest leave-pair-out CV); gate the GSE port on the reproducible test.

title: Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics with Conformal Prediction
improvement: GSE adds EnbPI 90% conformal bands to per-game win-prob trajectory forecasts with a 4-week sliding calibration window, and reports feature-conformal intervals per coefficient on the SINDy-discovered 'laws of the game' equations.
gate: ADOPT if EnbPI 90% bands achieve empirical coverage in [88%, 95%] on the 2025 rolling-origin test with mean width <= the naive baseline AND >=80% of SINDy equation terms survive the feature-CP zero-exclusion check across all 2025 windows.

title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning on Path-dependent Options
improvement: GSE adds season-level risk reporting: an RBF-quantile model over (bankroll, running profit, weeks remaining) learns the distribution of season profit each week, reporting P(season profit < 0) and CVaR to size down before tail events.
gate: ADOPT iff on 2023-2024 the RBF-quantile model's season-profit quantile ECE <=0.05 AND it beats the Monte Carlo baseline on CVaR_0.1 absolute error by >=10% relative.

title: (Exhaustive) Symbolic Regression and model selection by minimum description length
improvement: GSE adopts the MDL formula as its standard equation-selection metric for symbolic regression (replacing PySR's heuristic score), with an exhaustive pre-screen over precomputed sports-plausible operator sets.
gate: ADOPT if the MDL top-ranked equation beats the incumbent baseline on 2025 held-out log-likelihood by >=0.005 nats/game AND the ranking is stable (top-3 unchanged under 5-fold season-block CV) AND the winner has <=10 terms.

title: Isotonic Quantile Regression Averaging for uncertainty quantification
improvement: GSE replaces Lasso-tuned quantile postprocessing with iQRA: nonnegative-constrained quantile regression on a sorted ensemble of point predictions — 30x faster, no lambda grid, with free variable selection that picks ensemble extremes for the tails.
gate: CPA: iQRA significantly outperforms unconstrained QRA at 1% on CRPS; ACE at 90% within +-1 pp of nominal; compute budget <1 minute per daily batch.

title: The uncertainty of a tournament draw: Insights from the Champions League
improvement: GSE decomposes futures prices into draw luck vs true skill: per-team draw-uncertainty SDs reported alongside outright prices, with seeding-error attribution repricing futures under perfect-seeding draws.
gate: ADAPT iff draw uncertainty is material: compute per-team draw-uncertainty SDs for the next priced tournament; if the median team's SD exceeds ~15% of its mean outright probability, the decomposition ships.

title: SV3.3B: A Sports Video Understanding Model for Action Recognition
improvement: GSE ports only the DWT-VGG16-LDA keyframe sampler into its video pipeline: NFL clips become 8-16 representative stills via motion-map + appearance features + LDA nearest-to-center selection, for thumbnails, telestration frames, and highlight-cut candidates.
gate: Adopt the sampler if on 50 NFL clips the editor-preference test shows >=60% preference over uniform sampling AND mean phase coverage improves by >=1 phase per clip, with runtime <30s per 10s clip on CPU.

title: Convergence Rate of Efficient MCMC with Ancillarity-Sufficiency Interweaving Strategy for Panel Data Models
improvement: GSE implements ASIS interweaving in its hierarchical samplers: for team-level random-effect models, the variance-ratio rule picks centered vs non-centered starts and interweaving keeps mixing fast across both regimes.
gate: Adopt ASIS into the sampler stack if a local re-implementation reproduces ASIS MCSE <= best-single-scheme MCSE in at least 10 of the 12 paper settings AND the Corollary 1 ordering holds in all 12.

title: CNN-based Surface Temperature Forecasts with Ensemble Numerical Weather Prediction
improvement: GSE builds a CNN temperature downscaler: GEFS/HRRR channels trained against NOAA RTMA over NFL stadium neighborhoods, applied member-wise to all 31 ensemble members and combined with the conformal layer.
gate: ADOPT if the CNN beats the lapse-rate baseline by >=20% RMSE on 2023 stadium data AND the FI/NE check confirms maintained frequency of improvements; REJECT if gain <20% and rely on the LGBM temperature recipe.

title: Attention-Driven Multimodal Alignment for Long-term Action Quality Assessment
improvement: GSE treats each drive as a 'long video' with multimodal alignment: learnable queries per modality (tracking, broadcast video, audio, text) attend over plays with a consistency loss, producing drive scores and publishable per-play weights.
gate: ACCEPT if the LMAC-style model beats the concat baseline by >=0.04 Spearman on 2024 drives AND the consistency-loss ablation shows a positive contribution (>=+0.01); REJECT on no gain over concat.

title: Inference in a generalized Bradley-Terry model for paired comparisons with covariates and a growing number of subjects
improvement: GSE replaces its plain Bradley-Terry/Elo win-probability core with CBTM: team merits plus covariates (home, rest differential, travel miles, QB-change flag, dome/outdoor mismatch), refit weekly with Ford fixed-point + Newton-Raphson sweeps.
gate: On the NFL 2019-2023 walk-forward test, CBTM log-loss must beat plain BT by >=0.01 and must not lose to the current rating model; home-effect coefficient significant (|gamma|/SE>3) in >=4 of 5 seasons.

title: Predicting Formula 1 Race Outcomes: Decomposing the Roles of Drivers and Constructors through Linear Modeling
improvement: GSE decomposes EPA variance into scheme vs personnel shares with ridge regression on team/coach-unit/player indicators under exponential time decay, LOESS-smoothing coefficient paths into ratings.
gate: Adopt if the ridge+LOESS pilot beats the team-average carry-forward baseline by >=5% MAE on 2024 holdout weeks AND the variance-share decomposition is stable across two seasons (constructor-analogue share within +-10pp).

title: BioDisco: Multi-agent hypothesis generation with dual-mode evidence, iterative feedback and temporal evaluation
improvement: GSE adds a pre-execution evidence + critic stage to its discovery loop: every hypothesis gets dual-mode grounding (structured nflverse base-rate checks + literature novelty search) and a critic score on novelty and verifiability before backtest compute is spent.
gate: ADOPT if arm B's gate-pass rate >= arm A's while using <=60% of the backtest compute, the temporal-rediscovery check recovers >=2/3 known edges, and Bradley-Terry ratings rank-order signals consistently after 4 weeks.

title: Leveraging Minute-by-Minute Soccer Match Event Data to Adjust Team's Offensive Production for Game Context
improvement: GSE ships game-script-adjusted efficiency metrics: GAMs on EPA/play and count stats projected onto a neutral script (score differential, time, pre-game spread controlled), so 'good teams trailing' aren't misread as 'bad offenses'.
gate: ADOPT if adjusted stats correlate >=0.03 better with season point differential than raw stats AND beat raw stats in LOSOCV margin forecasting at p<0.05.

title: Bayesian weighted discrete-time dynamic models for association football prediction
improvement: GSE ports commensurate-precision time-weighting into its team-strength dynamics: older seasons' information enters through a commensurate prior that borrows aggressively when consistent and discounts when the game evolves.
gate: Adopt if on the 2025 walk-forward test the weighted-dynamic model's RPS beats both baselines (current + constant-variance RW) by >=0.003 absolute AND mean |edge vs de-vigged close| improves CLV hit-rate by >=1.0pp.

title: Chain-of-Alpha: Unleashing the Power of Large Language Models for Alpha Mining in Quantitative Trading
improvement: GSE mines alpha factors with an LLM generation/optimization chain: the model proposes formulas over nflverse and line-move features, parsed via a safe evaluator and backtested on RankIC, RankICIR, turnover, and novelty against the effective pool.
gate: ADAPT->build if the LLM chain's selected factor set beats the GP baseline's set by >=0.002 Brier on 2022-2025 AND at least 5 factors survive Benjamini-Hochberg (q<0.10) on the test block; REJECT if LLM factors are regurgitated known signals.

title: Ledger 0795 — Bayesian Forecast Combination with Predictive Priors via Particle Filtering (DTVW)
improvement: GSE replaces static ensemble weights with DTVW diversity-driven Bayesian time-varying weights: sources that disagree productively get upweighted automatically when the world changes, and correlated redundant signals are penalized — GSE's ensemble layer for combining engine, market, and consensus signals.
gate: ADAPT if DTVW implements the self-tuning diversity mechanism with burn-in-tuned initialization and clears a >=2% CRPS gate on the density forecasts; it answers ledger 0790's correlation-robustness problem from the Bayesian side.

title: Uncertainty-Driven Reliability: Selective Prediction and Trustworthy Deployment in Modern Machine Learning
improvement: GSE feeds per-pick prediction instability (checkpoint disagreement or seeded-bagging disagreement across 10 seeds) as a feature into the posting gate, so picks whose predictions wobbled during training are held back.
gate: ADOPT if at c=0.70 on 2024-2025 engine picks, instability-selected picks beat confidence-top-70% selection by >=1.0pp hit rate (or +1.0pp cover rate for spreads), two-sided McNemar p<0.10.

title: Selective Prediction Reduces the Negative Effects of Automation Bias Overall but Increases False Negatives
improvement: GSE frames every abstention in X copy as a +EV pass, never a bare 'no play': 'No edge today on [game] — model sees it as a coin flip, not a fade,' and A/B tests silent vs announced abstention on low-stakes slates for follower trust.
gate: ADAPT iff the paper's core mechanism (announced abstention read as a negative signal) transfers to a betting audience by the availability-bias argument; REJECT any claim about effect magnitude from the paper.

title: TOTNet: Occlusion-Aware Temporal Tracking for Robust Ball Detection in Sports Videos
improvement: GSE ports the cheap framework-independent tracking ideas: visibility-weighted loss (re-weight by occlusion proxy) and occlusion augmentation (mask the ball region in training) for any future vision-based tracking build.
gate: Adopt the WBCE + occlusion-augmentation recipe if a GSE tracking trainer's fully-occluded-frame RMSE improves by >=15% over the unweighted-loss control on a held-out NFL broadcast clip set with synthetic occlusion labels, with no regression on fully-visible frames.

title: OpenFPL: An Open-Source Forecasting Method Rivaling State-of-the-Art Fantasy Premier League Services
improvement: GSE adapts the OpenFPL recipe for fantasy projections: position-specific XGBoost+RF ensembles over 1/3/5/10/17-game horizons, entropy-binning sample weights toward high-ceiling outcomes, team-split CV, and prospective evaluation.
gate: ADAPT if Test 1 passes (beats baselines overall and on ceiling games); REJECT if it can't beat GSE's existing projections on 2024 holdout or the ceiling-weighting trick doesn't transfer.

title: VIFSS: View-Invariant and Figure Skating-Specific Pose Representation Learning for Temporal Action Segmentation
improvement: GSE makes pose-from-video embeddings viewpoint-robust with the VIFSS two-stage recipe: pretrain on public 3D pose datasets with virtual-camera augmentation, fine-tune on GSE-labeled NFL action clips for throwing/tackling mechanics features.
gate: Adopt if the pretrained encoder beats the scratch encoder by >=5 points on cross-view action accuracy on the 300-clip NFL test AND same-action cross-view embedding similarity exceeds different-action same-view similarity.

title: TrajSV: A Trajectory-based Model for Sports Video Representations and Applications
improvement: GSE builds a 'similar-play retrieval' layer over its film/tracking archive: NGS tracking rasterized to field-grid segment matrices, Jaccard-tokenized, encoded by the Transformer CRNet — given a play, retrieve the K most tactically similar historical plays.
gate: Adopt if on the 200-query expert set it beats BOTH baselines on MRR by >=15% relative AND a blind scout review rates >=60% of its top-5 retrievals 'tactically similar'; REJECT if it fails to beat raw-tracking kNN.

title: Enhancing GraphQL Security by Detecting Malicious Queries Using Large Language Models, Sentence Transformers, and Convolutional Neural Networks
improvement: GSE applies the static-gate security doctrine to the Kit/SignPreview Vercel apps: deterministic input validation (payload caps, character allowlists, edge rate limits) as the hard gate, ML detection only as additive telemetry — never as the sole block decision.
gate: ADAPT the static-gate doctrine iff the 7-day log review shows >=1 credible malicious-shape request blocked per week with zero false positives on legitimate leads; reject any LLM-in-the-security-path component unconditionally.

title: AlphaEval: A Comprehensive and Efficient Evaluation Framework for Formula Alpha Mining
improvement: GSE adopts AlphaEval as its standard signal-validation harness: PPS (IC/RankIC vs cover residual), RRE (week-to-week rank stability), PFS (perturbation/shock robustness), and LLM plausibility scoring into one integrated selection score.
gate: ADAPT->build if integrated-score selection beats IC-only selection by >=0.002 Brier on 2022-2025 AND evaluation runs >=10x faster than the equivalent walk-forward backtest; REJECT if dimensions are mutually redundant (pairwise |corr|>0.8).

title: A Comparative Study of Delta Parquet, Iceberg, and Hudi for Automotive Data Engineering Use Cases
improvement: GSE standardizes on Delta Lake for gold feature tables and the ML training path (Spark-native integration, schema enforcement at write time, time travel), adding Iceberg only if a second query engine enters the picture.
gate: CONFIRM Delta iff on GSE's 5-season replay: Delta's point-in-time range-query latency is within 20% of Iceberg's AND total storage is within 15% of Iceberg's.

title: Personalized Contest Recommendation in Fantasy Sports
improvement: GSE personalizes its ranking surfaces (which picks/articles/contests each subscriber sees, notification priority) with a three-tower model on implicit feedback: user tower, item tower, and interaction tower trained with pairwise hinge loss.
gate: ADAPT if the offline test beats the LightGBM baseline by >=5% relative on P/R@5 on the time-ordered test window; REJECT if the deep model can't beat gradient boosting at GSE's data scale.

title: ELATE: Evolutionary Language model for Automated Timeseries Engineering
improvement: GSE mines features with ELATE: an LLM invents rolling, matchup-adjusted, and weather-interaction features under a past-only prompt contract, and TreeSHAP walk-forward pruning selects the top-50 for the production XGBoost.
gate: ADAPT if >=0.003 held-out NFL log-loss improvement on the 2025 test games vs the no-LLM-feature baseline, with no post-kickoff leakage (AST scan shows zero negative shifts; all aggregations causal), and >=60% of selected features passing human review.

title: BasketLiDAR: The First LiDAR-Camera Multimodal Dataset for Professional Basketball MOT
improvement: GSE adopts the occlusion-triggered repair design pattern for its film-analysis tracking tooling: primary tracker on the wide view, occlusion trigger on track-count drops, ReID repair from the alternate view — a pattern for college film where NGS is unavailable.
gate: Adopt the repair pattern if on the 50-play occlusion test it reduces ID switches by >=30% vs the single-view baseline with per-play latency overhead <=2x; REJECT if ID-switch reduction <30% or the trigger fires on >20% of non-occluded frames.

title: Dynamic Graph-Based Forecasts of Bookmakers' Odds in Professional Tennis
improvement: GSE forecasts bookmaker odds with a dynamic graph model: offensive/defensive ratings fit by weighted least squares on historical log-transformed spreads with geometric time decay, forecasting opening/closing spread+total for any matchup and flagging news-driven anomalies.
gate: ADAPT if on 2024 holdout: (a) closing-spread MAE <=3.0 points AND beats carry-forward by >=0.75 points, or (b) the anomaly detector flags >=10 verifiable news-driven line moves with precision >=50%; REJECT if neither holds.

title: Sizing the Risk: Kelly, VIX, and Hybrid Approaches in Put-Writing on Index Options
improvement: GSE adds a volatility-regime stake-scaling overlay on constrained Kelly: multiply base size by (1 - rank of recent realized pick-PnL volatility) so stakes shrink after volatile stretches, or a drawdown-proximity CPPI-style scaler.
gate: ADOPT the overlay if walk-forward max drawdown drops >=15% vs Kelly-only at equal-or-better Sharpe; REJECT if the regime signal adds nothing (the paper's own OOS is compromised, so the burden of proof is on our backtest).

title: SportSQL: An Interactive System for Real-Time Sports Reasoning and Visualization
improvement: GSE ships SportSQL: a natural-language query layer over the Neon Postgres engine outputs (read-only role, statement timeouts, row limits, dataframe verification gate) so Garrett asks questions of the engine in plain English.
gate: ADOPT iff it reaches >=75% overall correctness on the NFL benchmark (matching the paper's GPT-4o 0.75) with zero write queries escaping the read-only guard over the full test set; reject visualization automation on failure.

title: Evaluating Movement Initiation Timing in Ultimate Frisbee via Temporal Counterfactuals
improvement: GSE builds a route-timing causal metric on NGS tracking: detect WR route-break initiations, generate xi-shifted counterfactuals, score with an expected-completion-value surface, and serve per-receiver timing bias (chronically early/late breakers) into prop models.
gate: Accepted: genuine temporal-counterfactual causal method for tracking data with open code; the small single-team sample limits the paper's own conclusions but the NGS application is concrete.

title: Tackling estimation risk in Kelly investing using options
improvement: GSE sizes stakes as a belief-mixture Kelly: a fixed convex mixture of 2-3 model-belief Kelly fractions (base, shrunk-edge, aggressive), logging each belief's standalone bankroll to verify the mixture never underperforms the best single belief — estimation-risk-robust sizing.
gate: Gate (pre-GSE): at n=300 across the paper's um misspecification grid, KOc's average per-period log-growth must be >= the best of {KS, KO1, KO2} at every grid point within Monte Carlo error (N=500, +-2 SE).

title: Hierarchy and ranking in pairwise sports contests
improvement: GSE tracks cycle-enrichment as a quarterly rating-model diagnostic: observed 3-cycles (rock-paper-scissors results) in the season's win graph vs the rating-implied expected distribution — positive enrichment means ratings are overconfident in hierarchy.
gate: ADOPT as a standing quarterly check if |z|>2 in >=3 of the last 6 seasons; REJECT as a standing diagnostic if |z|<=2 consistently.

title: Integrating Large Language Models with Network Optimization for Interactive and Explainable Supply Chain Planning: A Real-World Case Study
improvement: GSE adds an LLM explanation layer behind its serving API: deterministic optimizers stay the sole source of numbers; one LLM drafts role-specific copy from optimizer JSON, a second (or deterministic) checker verifies numeric consistency before anything publishes.
gate: ADAPT iff the LLM+checker pipeline achieves >=98% numeric faithfulness on the 1-week DFS test set AND Garrett rates >=70% of write-ups as publishable-with-minor-edits; reject the two-LLM reflection if single-LLM + deterministic checker matches.

title: A novel methodological framework for analyzing the momentum effect in tennis singles
improvement: GSE adds CUSUM momentum-flow features to the live game model: a composite drive-flow index (EWM over EPA/drive, success rate, explosive-play rate, turnover/3-and-out penalties) with CUSUM change-point detection within each game.
gate: ADOPT if CUSUM flow features improve the game-model log-loss >=0.002 on the 2022-2024 holdout or the chi-square test shows >=2pp conditional-probability effects.

title: A Composite-Loss Graph Neural Network for the Multivariate Post-Processing of Ensemble Weather Forecasts
improvement: GSE builds a GraphSAGE joint-ensemble weather model over 30 stadium nodes (edges by stadium similarity, not raw distance), outputting K-member joint ensembles of temp/wind/precip trained with energy-score + variogram-score loss.
gate: ADOPT if dualGNN beats the best two-step (EMOS/DRN + ECC) on VS by >=3% with per-stadium CRPS no worse; REJECT if VS gain <3% and keep per-stadium models + ECC.

title: Knowledge Integration for Physics-informed Symbolic Regression Using Pre-trained Large Language Models
improvement: GSE adds an LLM-judge term to its PySR symbolic regression loss, scoring equations on bound-consistency, football realism, and simplicity so the Pareto front is dominated by domain-valid equations.
gate: ADOPT if LLM-term runs achieve >=80% domain-validity on the Pareto front (vs <=50% without) AND validation Brier degrades by <=5% relative AND per-generation wall-clock overhead <2x.

title: Bayesian Stacking via Proper Scoring Rule Optimization Using a Gibbs Posterior
improvement: GSE replaces ad-hoc ensemble weights with Bayesian stacking via proper scoring rules: a Gibbs posterior over component weights (Dirichlet prior, log-score criterion) with a dynamic weekly-discounted mode for in-season skill drift.
gate: ADOPT SGP (static or dynamic, whichever tunes better) if 2025 walk-forward log-loss improves >=0.005 over the best baseline (DM p<0.05) without a Brier regression; REJECT otherwise.

title: The Actuary's Final Word on Algorithmic Decision Making
improvement: GSE adopts an actuary-grade engine-honesty doctrine: Brier/log-loss as the primary metric on every evaluation slice, a logged override audit scoring human overrides against the engine quarterly, and a staleness check that retires models whose Brier degrades.
gate: Adopt the doctrine if either: (a) the override audit shows human overrides do not beat the engine on Brier over >=100 overridden games (if they do, adopt the override features into the model instead), or (b) the staleness check shows >=0.005 Brier degradation second-half.

title: Who Has the Best Probabilities? Luck Versus Skill in Prediction Tournaments
improvement: GSE adds a 'skill-vs-luck' panel to the weekly engine report: score gaps between engine and market-implied probabilities with sigma bounds, enforcing the 0.02-over-100-games 2-sigma rule before any public 'we're sharper than the market' claim or hit-streak promo.
gate: ADOPT the panel if the 2022-2024 backtest reproduces the paper's arithmetic cleanly (sigma bound behaves, Delta approx normal under shuffle); public skill claims only when |Delta|>2sigma.

title: Match Chat: Real Time Generative AI and Generative Computing for Tennis
improvement: GSE ports the live-likelihood momentum-blend pattern to NFL: pre-game engine win probability anchored with a per-drive momentum term (cumulative EPA delta vs expected, leverage-weighted by score differential x time remaining) and calibrated decay.
gate: Adopt the momentum-blend live model as GSE's in-play WP/spread component if on the 2022-2024 test window it beats nflfastR in-game WP on mean log-loss by >=0.005 AND the fitted decay lambda > 0.

title: A hidden benefit of incomplete round-robin tournaments: Encouraging offensive play
improvement: GSE adds format-aware attacking-incentive covariates to its soccer totals model: precomputed incentive surfaces (marginal qualification value of a goal given format, matchday, table position) fed into the goal-expectancy model.
gate: ADAPT iff the incentive predicts real goals: on post-reform UCL league-phase data, high-incentive matches show higher total goals (or higher goal-supremacy vs market) than low-incentive matches with similar team strengths.

title: Are Final Market Prices Sufficient for Information Aggregation? Evidence from Last-Minute Dynamics in Parimutuel Betting
improvement: GSE builds steam-detection features from timestamped sharp-book odds: late-window move velocity, acceleration, and path convexity as pick-model features, backtesting a 'follow sharp late steam' rule at post-move prices with slippage.
gate: ADAPT confirmed if late-move features add significant explanatory power for CLV beyond final odds (p<0.01 on the move coefficient in at least one league); if no league shows the effect, record the parimutuel-specific boundary.

title: BlurBall: Joint Ball and Motion Blur Estimation for Table Tennis Ball Tracking
improvement: GSE adopts the blur-label schema (midpoint + blur vector) for ball detection on broadcast video, improving position/velocity estimates in the first frames after release where motion blur is worst.
gate: Adopt the blur-label schema if the blur-aware detector beats the center-point baseline by >=2 F1 points on the NFL test set AND position+blur trajectory fitting reduces catch-point MAE vs NGS ground truth by >=25% relative to position-only.

title: Rethinking Player Evaluation in Sports: Goals Above Expectation and Beyond
improvement: GSE publishes a weekly QB leaderboard of robust CATE estimates (rCPAE with valid CIs) correcting for selection bias via per-QB propensity scores — a QB evaluation product grounded in causal inference.
gate: ADOPT as a GSE QB-evaluation product only if: (a) the reproduction matches the paper's ordering within the top 10 (+-2 rank tolerance), (b) >=5 QBs show BH-significant positive effects per season, and (c) the robustness slop checks pass.

title: Knowing When to Defer: Selective Prediction for Responsible Knowledge Tracing
improvement: GSE defers picks by prediction uncertainty: M=50-100 stochastic forward passes (or seeded-bootstrap disagreement for non-dropout models) per candidate pick, deferring the most uncertain fraction to hit target posting coverage.
gate: ADOPT if on the 2024-2025 test window MC-variance abstention at c=0.80 lifts cover/hit rate by >=1.5pp over no-abstention AND beats the |p-0.5| heuristic by >=1.0pp, with deferred-set error ratio >=1.3 vs kept set.

title: Strategic Play and Home Advantage: Coaches' Tactical Impact in Serie A
improvement: GSE builds a coaching-decision analytics module: per-game NFL coaching aggressiveness indices (early-down pass rate vs expectation, 4th-down go-rate vs WP model, blitz rate) with triple-outcome panel econometrics and exhaustive model averaging.
gate: Accepted: real hand-built dataset, fully specified triple-model econometrics, exhaustive model averaging (393/317/107 specs), bootstrap-validated inference with strong stable headline effects.

title: 3DPCNet: Pose Canonicalization for Robust Viewpoint-Invariant 3D Kinematic Analysis from Monocular RGB cameras
improvement: GSE canonicalizes 3D player poses from heterogeneous NFL camera angles into a common field frame, making pose-derived features (joint angles, posture metrics) comparable across broadcast, All-22, and end-zone views.
gate: Adopt the canonicalization layer if on real multi-angle NFL film it reduces cross-view MPJPE by >=20% vs the geometric baseline AND median frame-to-frame rotation jitter is <=2 degrees after temporal smoothing.

title: Biomechanical-phase based Temporal Segmentation in Sports Videos: a Demonstration on Javelin-Throw
improvement: GSE segments NFL plays into biomechanical/tactical phases (presnap -> dropback -> throw -> catch/RAC; pass-rush phases) with unsupervised optimal-transport segmentation on NGS tracking, with K selected automatically.
gate: Adopt the OT-segmentation layer if, with K selected automatically (no oracle), it matches or beats the supervised BiLSTM baseline on boundary F1 (+-3 frames) on the 500-play validation set AND phase mIoU >=0.55.

title: Aging Decline in Basketball Career Trend Prediction Based on Machine Learning and LSTM Model
improvement: GSE forecasts veteran aging curves with an archetype-conditioned forecaster: autoencoder + K-means career archetypes (early-peak, late-bloomer, cliff) fed into an LSTM predicting next-season efficiency for prop/DFS projections.
gate: Adopt into the prop/DFS projection pipeline if on the 2023-2024 holdout it beats the last-value baseline on MAE for veterans AND archetype assignments are stable across bootstrap re-clustering (Jaccard >=0.7).

title: Continuous Space-Time Video Super-Resolution with 3D Fourier Fields
improvement: GSE restores low-quality film (old All-22, compressed clips, grainy sideline footage) with a V3 super-resolution enhancement layer before visual review or detection/pose pipelines — never as a tracking-data source.
gate: Adopt if V3-restored frames beat bicubic by >=2 dB PSNR on the realistic NFL degradation set AND the detection-mAP check on restored frames recovers >=50% of the mAP lost to degradation.

title: Z-scores-based methods and their application to biological monitoring: An extended analysis of professional soccer players and cyclists athletes
improvement: GSE monitors every player weekly with an anomaly-scan over longitudinal series (NGS max speed, burst accelerations, snap share, practice participation): interval change-point scans flag 2-4 game deviations as fatigue/overtraining/role-change early warnings ahead of injury absence.
gate: ADOPT if on 2023-2024 holdout T_n^(2) flags precede injury absence with recall >=25% at <=10% flag rate among healthy player-weeks, opponent-adjusted flags beat raw flags by >=5pp precision, and the nominal 5% false-positive rate holds.

title: On The Statistical Limits of Self-Improving Agents
improvement: GSE promotes discovery-loop candidates under a Two-Gate policy: Gate 1 requires the lower bound of the bootstrap CI of delta-Brier to exceed 0.001 (margin, not a point estimate); Gate 2 caps a complexity proxy B (free params + engineered features + rule count) by a training-size-scaled K(m).
gate: ADOPT if arm B's locked-season degradation rate is <=50% of arm A's AND arm B retains >=70% of arm A's total locked-season delta-Brier, and the complexity proxy B correlates negatively with degradation.

title: Rethinking HTTP API Rate Limiting: A Client-Side Approach
improvement: GSE adopts ATB adaptive token-bucket retry as the default backoff policy for its data-fetch harness (Odds API, FreePublicAPIs, TheSportsDB, nflverse CDN), replacing naive fixed-sleep/exponential-backoff in all fetch scripts.
gate: ADOPT iff 429s drop >=50% vs the fixed-sleep baseline with completion-time increase <=30% over the 1-week test; reject as unnecessary if 429s are already ~zero.

title: StruSR: Structure-Aware Symbolic Regression with Physics-Informed Taylor Guidance
improvement: GSE distills its neural win-probability model into guided symbolic equations: the network trains with a domain-constraint loss, Taylor expansions at ~200 anchor game-states guide the GP, and masking attribution protects high-sensitivity subtrees.
gate: ADAPT if the guided-GP equation reaches sensitivity-fidelity correlation >=0.9 with the network (vs <=0.7 for vanilla PySR) at validation Brier within 2% of the network's, AND converges in <=50% of the generations vanilla PySR needs.

title: When In Doubt, Abstain: The Impact of Abstention on Strategic Classification
improvement: GSE stress-tests its public picks against market response: sweep adverse line moves k=0..1.5 points against each posted pick, find the k* where edge turns negative, and pre-apply an elevated abstention threshold to high-profile posted picks.
gate: ADAPT accepted if the stress test finds a stable turning point k* where posted-pick edge at the moved line turns negative AND the elevated gate recovers positive units in the high-movement regime.

title: Bayes-ically fair: A Bayesian Ranking of the Olympic Medal Table
improvement: GSE replaces every small-sample raw rate in its feature stack (kicker FG% by distance, red-zone TD%, 4th-down conversion, turnover recovery) with hierarchical Beta-Binomial posterior means, carrying the credible-interval width as an explicit uncertainty feature.
gate: ADOPT league-wide hierarchical shrinkage if the posterior-mean predictor beats the raw rate on second-half log-loss by >=0.01 in >=7 of 10 seasons (2015-2024).

title: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting
improvement: GSE fine-tunes Chronos-2-base (120M) on NFL/NCAA game groups with SFF init and quantile loss, serving 21-quantile joint distributions so spread, total, and prop pricing come from one consistent model with no cross-model disagreement.
gate: ADOPT for joint game pricing if fine-tuned Chronos-2 beats the best univariate-per-target baseline on joint scaled-quantile-loss skill over 2022-2024 AND its 80%/95% interval coverage is within +-4 pts of nominal on every target.

title: Convolutional Attention in Betting Exchange Markets
improvement: GSE predicts closing-line move direction from pre-kickoff line-movement sequences: an LSTM-attention model over spread/total snapshots, cross-book dispersion, book count, and steam indicators as a 3-class classifier feeding a wait/bet timing rule.
gate: ADAPT if the LSTM-attention model on 2024 holdout: (a) beats baselines by >=3pp accuracy on 3-class line-move direction, AND (b) the wait/bet timing backtest shows >=+0.5 points mean CLV improvement.

title: Are penalty shootouts better than a coin toss? Evidence from international club football in Europe
improvement: GSE tests the NFL-overtime analog: binomial and logistic tests on coin-toss winner, first-possession, and strength-controlled OT win rates across rule eras, adopting an OT toss/possession adjustment in the simulator only on significance.
gate: ADOPT an OT first-possession/toss adjustment in the GSE sim only if the first-possession win rate differs from 50% at 5% significance on the 2012-2025 sample AND the logistic first-possession coefficient is significant at 5% after controlling for Elo difference.

title: 1722 Moneyball with LLMs: analyzing tabular summarization in sports narratives
improvement: GSE extracts facts from NFL game narratives as atomic (Entity, Attribute, Value, Evidence-span) tuples compiled by a rule-based unit-tested aggregator with conflict flagging, scoring over/under-count separately via the HOI metric.
gate: ADAPT the T3 recipe (tuple extraction + rule-based compiler + HOI) with the two hardening modifications (evidence spans, conflict flagging); the raw T3 is rejected for production without them.

title: FST.ai 2.0: An Explainable AI Ecosystem for Fair, Fast, and Inclusive Decision-Making in Olympic and Paralympic Taekwondo
improvement: GSE gates X auto-posting on a credal rule: a pick posts automatically only if the lower bound of its probability interval clears tau (~0.55); otherwise it routes to the analyst approve-desk — an explainable auto-post filter with a full audit log.
gate: Adopt the credal pick gate only if backtesting on the 2024 season shows >=2pp ROI improvement on auto-posted picks vs unfiltered posting AND >=60% of picks still clear the gate; REJECT if the interval estimates are miscalibrated.

title: Policy Learning with Abstention
improvement: GSE replaces the single post/no-post threshold with committee disagreement: K=10 near-optimal pick-selection rules, abstain when they disagree — plus a safe-upgrade protocol (LCB gate) that blocks new engine versions failing on recent graded picks.
gate: ADAPT the disagreement rule iff it beats the single-threshold rule by >=2 selective-ROI points at matched abstention rate on the chronological test block; ADAPT the LCB upgrade gate iff it blocks the known-bad candidate while passing the known-good one.

title: A Theoretical Comparison of Weight Constraints in Forecast Combination and Model Averaging
improvement: GSE runs the paper's weight-constraint horse race on its ensemble layer: fit combination weights under five constraint spaces on rolling windows, select via a three-way fit/calibrate-conformal/select split, and ship the winner as the default constraint.
gate: ADOPT the winning weight space as the ensemble default if it beats both unconstrained weights and equal weights by >=0.002 Brier on the 2025 rolling test (DM p<0.05) and the conformal-selection rule picks it in >=60% of selection windows.

title: Assessing win strength in MLB win prediction models
improvement: GSE adopts the win-strength diagnostic as a standing model check: bin games by predicted win-probability decile and require mean actual score differential to be monotone — catching tail miscalibration that proper scores miss.
gate: Adopt if on the 2025 test season at least one candidate engine model shows a non-monotonic or flat P(win)->margin relationship while matching competitors on Brier — the diagnostic catches a miscalibration that proper scores miss.

title: Multi-Objective Adaptive Rate Limiting in Microservices Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
improvement: GSE adds a constrained-MDP-style adaptive throttler to its data-fetch harness: state = per-API quota/time-to-reset/429-rate/latency/queue, actions = throttle-interval adjustments, starting with a rule-based AIMD controller before any RL.
gate: ADOPT the rule-based adaptive throttler iff 429 errors drop >=50% vs the fixed-interval baseline AND median full-pull completion time does not increase >20% on the 1-week test window; reject the neural-RL component unconditionally.

title: 1720 SportR: a benchmark for multimodal large language model reasoning in sports
improvement: GSE builds an NFL SportR analog: analysts write macro-to-micro chain-of-thoughts over All-22/broadcast frames, then SFT + GRPO a vision-language model on the progressive QA hierarchy for formation/coverage/outcome reasoning.
gate: ADAPT the recipe (progressive QA hierarchy + expert CoT + SFT/GRPO + error taxonomy), not a checkpoint; proceed if the 500-frame NFL pilot meets the accuracy criteria; REJECT the grounding task if analyst box-drawing fails.

title: MVU-Eval: Towards Multi-Video Understanding Evaluation for Multimodal LLMs
improvement: GSE builds GSE-MVU: a 200-500 QA-pair evaluation set over multi-angle NFL clips (broadcast + all-22 + end-zone) across 8 tasks, and adopts an MLLM for production clip work only if it clears a bar no current model meets.
gate: Adopt an MLLM for any GSE production clip task only if it scores >=70% overall on GSE-MVU AND >=60% on Spatial Understanding and KIR subtasks; REJECT as the evaluator's whole point is that the bar is aspirational.

title: Expected by Whom? A Skill-Adjusted Expected Goals Model for NHL Shooters and Goaltenders
improvement: GSE builds a player/context-adjusted expected-yards module for NFL props: gradient-boosted baseline on context features plus recency-weighted per-player yards-above-expected adjustments aggregated into field-zone bins.
gate: ADOPT if the skill-adjusted model beats the context-only baseline by >=0.02 RMSE yards/play reduction AND >=0.005 Brier improvement on the 2025 holdout, with gains in at least 3 of 4 position groups (QB, RB, WR, TE).

title: DreamPose3D: Hallucinative Diffusion with Prompt Learning for 3D Human Pose Estimation
improvement: GSE lifts 2D broadcast detections to 3D player poses with an intent-conditioned denoiser: an NFL action-prompt vocabulary (run, pass, play-action, screen, RPO, scramble, sack, punt, kick) disambiguates the lift, sitting between the 2D detector and the pose graph.
gate: Adopt the intent-conditioned lifter as GSE's 2D->3D front end only if on held-out broadcast sports footage it beats the intent-free variant by >=2mm mPJPE AND reduces trajectory jitter by >=15%.

title: Pixels or Positions? Benchmarking Modalities in Group Activity Recognition
improvement: GSE adopts a role-aware player graph as its play-classification backbone: 22 players + ball as nodes with functional-group edges (OL<->QB, QB<->skill, DL<->LB<->DB), classifying run/pass/screen/play-action/RPO/penalty/sack.
gate: Adopt only if it beats the no-edges baseline by >=5pp balanced accuracy AND the fully-connected baseline by >=3pp on held-out 2025 plays; REJECT the no-edge finding as the paper's positional-edge result is the hypothesis.

title: DeepSport: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Comprehensive Sports Video Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
improvement: GSE builds a film-analyst agent that actively interrogates game data: tools for tracking windows, video clips, pbp lookup, and stat queries, trained with a reward recipe that bonuses efficient tool use.
gate: ACCEPT if the tool-using agent beats one-shot by >=10 points accuracy on verifiable questions AND averages <=3 tool calls/question; REJECT if no accuracy gain from tool use or tool calls balloon.

title: Few-Shot Precise Event Spotting via Unified Multi-Entity Graph and Distillation
improvement: GSE spots broadcast events (snap, handoff, pass release, catch, tackle, TD, turnover, penalty flag) with a unified multi-entity graph: 22 player skeletons + ball keypoint + field landmarks, trained from ~100 labeled clips.
gate: Adopt the UMEG-Net spotter as GSE's broadcast event-spotter only if on held-out NFL games it beats E2E-Spot trained on the same 100 clips by >=3pp F1evt AND achieves Edit score >=50.

title: Darts Analysis
improvement: GSE adopts the betting-game harness as a standing model-comparison tool: every held-out season, models convert probabilities to fair odds and stake Kelly-fractional bets against each other — 'which model would make money against which' instead of Brier gaps alone.
gate: Adopt if on the 2024 held-out season it identifies at least one model pair whose profitability ranking reverses the Brier ranking AND results are stable under half-season splits.

title: FOOTPASS: A Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Tactical Context Dataset for Play-by-Play Action Spotting in Soccer Broadcast Videos
improvement: GSE builds a two-stage highlight pipeline for the clip workflow: off-the-shelf action detector producing noisy per-play event candidates from broadcast frames, denoised by a sequence model conditioned on nflverse play context.
gate: Adopt the two-stage pipeline for the clip workflow only if on the 10-game test set the denoised pipeline achieves >=80% recall at >=60% precision on highlight plays AND beats the detector-alone baseline by >=20pp precision at matched recall.

title: A Genetic Algorithm for Optimizing Fantasy Football Trades with Playoff Biasing
improvement: GSE ships a Trade Analyzer for season-long fantasy: a genetic algorithm over rosters and league-mate teams using GSE's own projections, with Monte Carlo upgrade showing which recommended trades stay positive under projection uncertainty.
gate: ADOPT as a GSE season-long product feature only if: (a) backtested recommended-trade projected gains correlate with realized gains at r>=0.5, (b) interactive runtime <10s per league, and (c) the Monte Carlo upgrade shows >=70% of recommended trades keep g_a>0.

title: Synthetic Data Generation for Pre-Injury Pattern Detection in Triathletes
improvement: GSE stands up a synthetic-injury sandbox with known injected mechanisms (load spikes -> soft-tissue risk with 3-10-day lags, prior-injury recurrence) and requires its availability model to recover the injected mechanisms before its real-data outputs are trusted.
gate: ADAPT the sandbox/negative-control protocol if GSE's availability model passes the >=80% attribution-recovery gate on the sandbox — then the sandbox becomes a standing regression test; REJECT the paper's 0.858 AUC / 0.726 AP as evidence about real injury predictability.

title: The Impacts of Increasingly Complex Matchup Models on Baseball Win Probability
improvement: GSE adopts hierarchical Bayesian log5 matchup models: QB-vs-defensive-unit and OL-vs-DL per-play success/turnover/explosive-play probabilities with scheme-matchup offsets and recency weighting, fit with NUTS.
gate: ADOPT if the unit-matchup model shows >=0.5% relative GMP improvement over the current baseline AND the decision simulation shows >=0.1 added wins/season attributable to the matchup upgrade.

title: Coherent Multi-Agent Trajectory Forecasting in Team Sports with CausalTraj
improvement: GSE ports coherent multi-agent trajectory forecasting to NGS tracking: predict the next 2.0s of all 22 players + ball with a structured ball-carrier/ball-loose mixture covariance and play-type/formation embeddings.
gate: Adopt if a CausalTraj port trained on BDB 2025 weeks 1-9 achieves on held-out weeks 10-18 minJADE20 within 10% of the reproduced paper baseline AND receiver-role minADE20 beats constant-velocity extrapolation by >=30%.

title: Large-Scale In-Game Outcome Forecasting for Match, Team and Players in Football using an Axial Transformer Neural Network
improvement: GSE builds its live in-game engine on an axial architecture over a player x timestep grid: per-drive summaries for 15-20 agents with axial attention, heads for receptions, receiving yards, rushing yards, and team totals.
gate: ADOPT if it beats static pre-game baselines on log-probability for the majority of prop heads on the 2024 holdout with <=1% consistency violations; REJECT if in-game updating adds nothing.

title: What If They Took the Shot? A Hierarchical Bayesian Framework for Counterfactual Expected Goals
improvement: GSE evaluates personnel with a hierarchical Bayesian framework: player deviations over expert priors (draft capital, college dominator, scouting grades) with counterfactual team-switch predictions for receivers.
gate: ADOPT for personnel evaluation if (a) player effects improve held-out log-loss by >=1% over the no-player-effect baseline on 2023 data, AND (b) counterfactual predictions for team-switchers beat the population baseline by >=5% RMSE.

title: Beyond Expected Goals: A Probabilistic Framework for Shot Occurrences in Soccer
improvement: GSE decomposes offensive threat into attempt-generation x conversion: P(deep pass attempt | dropback) and P(success | attempt) from nflverse features, aggregated to a drive-threat metric more stable week-to-week than EPA/play sums.
gate: Adopt if on 2025 held-out weeks the aggregated drive-threat metric beats the EPA/play-sum baseline on MAE with a paired week-level test at p<0.05 AND the attempt-generation component alone shows higher week-to-week stability.

title: Kicking for Goal or Touch? An Expected Points Framework for Penalty Decisions in Rugby Union
improvement: GSE ports the expected-points decision framework to 4th-down go/punt/FG and kickoff return-vs-touchback decisions: delta-EP/delta-WP indifference frontiers with sensitivity grids over kicker strength, weather, and team quality.
gate: Adopt the delta-frontier/regret framework for the coaching-decision product only if on 2022-2025 4th downs per-team regret rankings are stable year-over-year (Spearman >=0.4 across season pairs) AND delta-WP recommendations beat nfl4th on realized-WP regret by >=0.05 per decision.

title: Adaptive prediction theory combining offline and online learning
improvement: GSE adds an online meta layer over the frozen weekly engine: N=8-16 candidate drift models (linear probes on recent-form residuals, injury-adjusted roster deltas, market-move direction) reweighted weekly on the season's own outcomes.
gate: Adopt the meta layer if over the 2022-2025 walk-forward the meta-weighted forecast beats the frozen offline baseline by >=0.005 Brier (win prob) or >=0.15 points MAE vs close (spread/total), improvement concentrated in weeks 6-18, with no catastrophic weekly degradation.

title: COACH: Collaborative Agents for Contextual Highlighting — A Multi-Agent Framework for Sports Video Analysis
improvement: GSE builds GSE-COACH for the NFL content pipeline: a multi-agent video system with a Grounder (play/event localizer), a Critic (fact-checks script claims against nflverse/NGS data), and an Orchestrator — so highlight scripts are verified before they publish.
gate: Adopt if on the 3-game test (a) Grounder play-level F1 >=0.75 vs the generalist baseline, AND (b) the Critic catches >=90% of deliberately injected false stat claims in draft scripts.

title: Learning Heterogeneous Ordinal Graphical Models via Bayesian Nonparametric Clustering
improvement: GSE learns stable team archetypes (e.g., rush-heavy, explosive-dropback) from a Bayesian mixture of Gaussian graphical models over team-week metrics, adding archetype indicators as matchup features.
gate: ADOPT archetype features if (a) the MFM posterior puts >=80% mass on a single K in the 2015-2023 fit AND half-season ARI >=0.6, and (b) adding archetype indicators improves walk-forward ATS log-loss on 2024-2025 by >=0.003.

title: Robust Forecast Aggregation via Additional Queries
improvement: GSE interrogates its engine components with structured queries: base forecasts plus difference queries under player-out and line-move perturbations and conditional forecasts, with a covariance-overlap diagnostic pruning redundant components before aggregation.
gate: ADOPT structured model interrogation if adding difference-query features improves 2025 walk-forward log-loss by >=0.003 over base-forecast aggregation (DM p<0.05) AND the overlap diagnostic's redundancy calls are confirmed by ablation, with a cost veto if inference cost >5x.

title: Long-Sequence LSTM Modeling for NBA Game Outcome Prediction Using a Novel Multi-Season Dataset
improvement: GSE stacks a long-sequence LSTM/GRU prior over ~150-200 team games inside the existing ensemble as a fallback memory layer for regime shifts.
gate: ADOPT the LSTM-fallback prior if the stacked ensemble's log-loss on the 2023-2024 holdout beats the no-prior baseline by >=0.005 AND the LSTM component alone beats logistic regression on the same features.

title: Commanding the Foul Shot: A New Ensemble of Free Throw Metrics
improvement: GSE ships a 'Kicker Command' module: C = 1/(1 + mu^2 + sigma^2) computed from NGS kick trajectories and upright-crossing deviation, evaluated alongside raw FG% as a truer kicker skill measure.
gate: Adopt if first-half kicker command predicts second-half distance-adjusted FG% with significantly higher correlation than first-half raw FG% (p<0.05, paired bootstrap), OR if command identifies >=3 kickers/year whose raw FG% misstates true skill by >5pp.

title: Bridging Streaming Continual Learning via In-Context Large Tabular Models
improvement: GSE runs TabPFN as a weekly no-retraining challenger model with context slices: trailing-8-week plasticity games plus a diversified historical stability coreset (~500 games) rebuilt each week instead of retraining.
gate: ADOPT the LTM-context architecture as a challenger if on 2020-2025 walk-forward: TabPFN Brier is within 0.003 of the GBM baseline, ECE <=0.03 after temperature scaling, regime recovery occurs within 3 weeks on >=60% of episodes, and weekly CPU inference <60 sec.

title: A Critical Perspective on Finite Sample Conformal Prediction Theory in Medical Applications
improvement: GSE audits its deployed conformal/CQR intervals with a QC protocol: B=200 weekly-block bootstrap resamples, conditional-coverage histograms flagging intervals whose probability coverage falls >5pp below nominal, and enforced minimum calibration-window sizing — interval-honesty infrastructure.
gate: Adopt the QC protocol if the reproducible test shows >=10% of m=10 calibration resamples falling below 85% conditional coverage at nominal 90%, confirming the small-window hazard is real; then enforce the minimum-m rule and recalibration cadence.

title: Evaluating Weather Forecasts from a Decision Maker's Perspective
improvement: GSE selects weather data sources by decision calibration: cost gaps for stake/no-stake, totals, and DFS late swaps (Eqs. 1-4, 6) decide the feed, rather than CRPS alone.
gate: ADOPT decision-calibrated weather-source selection if the decision-chosen feed beats the CRPS-chosen feed by >=1% ROI on weather-relevant games in the 2024-2025 holdout AND the cost gap C_gap is smaller.

title: Model inference for ranking from pairwise comparisons
improvement: GSE replaces the fixed logistic win-probability kernel in its rating layer with a jointly learned Chebyshev-polynomial kernel (EM + belief propagation), learning sport-specific probability shapes and detecting favorite-longshot bias as a calibration correction.
gate: ADAPT iff the learned kernel beats the fixed logistic on GSE's own backtest: log-loss of kernel-learned win probabilities must be lower than logistic-baseline Bradley-Terry on at least two held-out NFL seasons.

title: Fairness, Travel, and Market Potential: An Optimization Framework for NBA Expansion
improvement: GSE adds theory-distance travel-burden differential (game-frequency-weighted travel over trailing days) as fatigue features in the NBA game model, alongside schedule-fairness auditing for released schedules.
gate: ADAPT iff travel-burden differential improves the NBA game model on rolling-origin log-loss beyond the ledger-1059 rest/travel features; keep the optimization/MIP template as content-only if distance adds nothing.

title: EventGPT: Capturing Player Impact from Team Action Sequences
improvement: GSE prototypes an EventGPT-like autoregressive drive-event model with player/QB conditioning and a residual future-EPA target, enabling counterfactual player-embedding substitution for scheme-fit simulations.
gate: ADAPT if on held-out 2024 drives the player-conditioned autoregressive model beats the game-state EPA regression on next-play yards MAE by >=5% AND the QB-substitution face-validity check passes (elite QB embedding raises predicted drive EPA in >=80% of weak-offense contexts).

title: Empirical parameterization of the Elo Rating System
improvement: GSE empirically tunes its Elo configuration: K grid over 1999-2015 histories with 2016-2025 walk-forward proper scores, fitting an empirical rating-difference to win-probability map.
gate: ADOPT the empirically tuned K/config if walk-forward Brier on 2016-2025 improves on convention Elo by >=0.002 AND the empirical expected-score map is monotone and within +/-3pp of the theoretical curve across rating diffs.

title: Deep Generative Models for Synthetic Financial Data: Applications to Portfolio and Risk Modeling
improvement: GSE trains a TimeGAN (or modern diffusion) generator on nflverse play sequences to produce synthetic game/drive scripts for engine stress testing, validated on fidelity, utility, and seed robustness.
gate: ADAPT if (a) TimeGAN synthetic seasons achieve KS <0.10 vs real on score-differential marginals AND beat game-level bootstrap resampling on that metric, AND (b) a calibrator trained on synthetic data is within 0.005 Brier of the real-trained calibrator on the 2025 holdout.

title: Analyzing Skill Element in Online Fantasy Cricket
improvement: GSE's DFS optimizer splits lineup generation by contest structure: GPP lineups maximize ceiling via stack-heavy, low-ownership diverse lineups while double-ups use high-floor median-optimized lineups.
gate: ADOPT only if the backtest reproduces the predicted ceiling/median crossover with statistical significance over >=1 full season and >=10% ROI difference between matched and mismatched strategy-contest pairs.

title: 1717 From evidence-based medicine to knowledge graph: retrieval-augmented generation for sports rehabilitation and a domain benchmark
improvement: GSE builds a tiered evidence-retrieval pipeline for injury news (T1 official reports outrank T4 social rumors), with schema-guided HyDE query expansion, a monotone-bias pairwise reranker, and faithfulness-constrained generation so every injury claim cites a retrieved source.
gate: ADAPT the architecture (tiered pools + schema-guided HyDE + monotone-bias reranker + faithfulness metric); proceed if the reproducible test meets faithfulness and conflict-resolution criteria on GSE's injury corpus.

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Off Ball Defensive Role and Performance Evaluation in Football
improvement: GSE fits a CDHMM over NGS tracking to decode each defender's coverage role (man vs zone landmark) per snap, producing a coverage-role ghosting module whose aggregated GCA adds predictive signal on targeted passer rating.
gate: Adopt if Viterbi role assignments agree with 200 hand-labeled coverage snaps at >=85% frame accuracy AND aggregated GCA adds >=0.05 incremental R^2 over PFF coverage grade on out-of-sample targeted passer rating.

title: Time-Aware Synthetic Control
improvement: GSE gains a time-aware synthetic control module that estimates the counterfactual impact of starting-QB injuries, coordinator changes, or rule changes on team EPA/play trajectories with 95% CIs validated by placebo tests on untreated teams.
gate: Adopt if TASC's median placebo RMSE beats classical synthetic control by >=10% relative AND beats the flat-carry baseline by >=15% in at least 4 of 6 seasons, with the stability signature in the d-sweep.

title: ReliabilityBench: Evaluating LLM Agent Reliability Under Production-Like Stress Conditions
improvement: GSE stands up a reliability benchmark harness for its tool-using agents, measuring performance R(k,eps,lam) under real fault modes (429s, quota exhaustion, schema changes) with deterministic state-based verifiers to decide which agents are cleared for unattended production.
gate: ADAPT if the GSE harness reproduces the paper's directional findings, costs <$25 per agent per full grid run, and deterministic verifiers cover >=80% of agent tasks.

title: Modeling Event Dynamics by Self-Exciting Processes with Random Memory
improvement: GSE models in-game scoring events as a self-exciting point process with a hot-state multiplier and random segment effects, enabling live models to exploit momentum clustering in TD/turnover/sack streams instead of assuming homogeneous Poisson scoring.
gate: ADAPT accepted if hot-state multiplier nu_hat is significantly > 0 (Wald p<0.01) with tau mean 1-6 min, Delta-BIC vs homogeneous Poisson > 10, and simulated cluster-size PMF matches empirical within 95% bands.

title: A probabilistic match classification model for low-scoring sports
improvement: GSE adds a match-class taxonomy (offensive-class, competitive-class, collusion-vulnerable) to its totals modeling so final-round group-stage fixtures are priced from class-specific scoring behavior rather than season averages.
gate: ADAPT iff match class predicts scoring behavior: high-kappa offensive-class fixtures show elevated totals and collusion-vulnerable fixtures show anomalous scoreline clustering vs competitive-class matches.

title: Corrected Forecast Combinations
improvement: GSE publishes corrected weekly consensus forecasts (forecast + gamma*previous-week error) per market, capturing the autocorrelated component of consensus error the market itself leaves uncorrected.
gate: ADOPT if baseline consensus errors show ACF(1) >= 0.15 AND the corrected consensus reduces margin RMSE by >=3% AND improves ATS Brier by >=1% on the 2024 holdout, with no single week contributing >25% of the gain.

title: ProbFM: Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Model with Uncertainty Decomposition
improvement: GSE attaches an evidential (NIG) head to the sports TSFM that decomposes uncertainty into epistemic (regime-change risk -> pick abstention and stake gating) and aleatoric (fair-price width -> no-bet zone) components.
gate: ADOPT if CRPS is within 1% of the quantile-head baseline, interval calibration within +-4 pts, AND epistemic-gated staking beats ungated on stake-weighted yield over 2022-2024.

title: BoxMind: Closed-loop AI strategy optimization for elite boxing validated in the 2024 Olympics
improvement: GSE adds a 'Strategy Gradient' layer to matchup previews: a differentiable team-style model computes dP(cover)/d(style-indicators) per game, surfacing the top-5 opponent-specific levers (e.g., blitz rate, personnel usage) that move cover probability.
gate: ADOPT if the fused model beats the Elo/spread baseline by >=3pp cover accuracy on 2023-2024 AND realized top-gradient levers show a statistically significant cover-rate advantage (p<0.05) over non-realized games.

title: Recent advances in the Bradley--Terry Model: theory, algorithms, and applications
improvement: GSE deploys a Bradley-Terry team-rating module with dynamic covariates (home, rest, travel, QB-out) fit by ridge MLE plus RankCentrality as the early-season fallback, beating plain BT and Elo on rolling log-loss.
gate: Adopt the PlusDC-BT module if on the 2022-2024 rolling test it beats both plain BT and Elo on mean log-loss by >=0.003 with plausible covariate signs; adopt RankCentrality as the weeks-1-4 fallback if it beats plain BT there.

title: Lineup Regularized Adjusted Plus-Minus (L-RAPM): Basketball Lineup Ratings with Informed Priors
improvement: GSE builds G-RAPM: group-adjusted EPA for sparse offensive personnel packages and receiver units, shrinking noisy small-sample estimates toward a member-rating prior so sparse groups are never rated worse than raw EPA/play.
gate: Adopt if on 2021-2024 G-RAPM beats raw group EPA/play on out-of-sample RMSE for sparse groups (<50 plays) in at least 3 of 4 seasons with >=3% relative improvement in the sparse bin and no bin underperforming by >1%.

title: Conformal Prediction Algorithms for Time Series Forecasting: Methods and Benchmarking
improvement: GSE wraps every engine point forecast in an MSCP multi-horizon conformal interval layer (rolling residuals with finite-sample correction, ACI fallback), so published picks carry honestly calibrated intervals by default.
gate: ADOPT MSCP as the default interval layer if it achieves >=90% empirical coverage with Winkler score >=5% below the parametric Gaussian benchmark on the engine backtest; adopt ACI instead if it significantly beats MSCP (Conover test).

title: The Blown Lead Paradox: Conditional Laws for the Running Maximum of Binary Doob Martingales
improvement: GSE gains a pathwise calibration monitor for its in-game win-probability model, testing the empirical CDF of losers' peak WP against the theoretical blown-lead law to catch models whose live paths are miscalibrated.
gate: ADOPT as the standing in-game WP diagnostic iff on 2023-2024 data the KS statistic is non-significant at alpha=0.05 in at least two of three pre-game favorite tiers AND first-passage overshoot > 5 WP points occurs in fewer than 25% of games.

title: Prediction Markets as Bayesian Inverse Problems: Uncertainty Quantification, Identifiability, and Information Gain from Price–Volume Histories under Latent Types
improvement: GSE weights its CLV edge aggregation by an information-gain measure of each line move, down-weighting noise-driven moves and refusing to update fair prices from games whose line history is flagged non-identifiable — CLV hygiene infrastructure, not a new alpha.
gate: ADAPT confirmed if IG-weighted CLV beats unweighted CLV on 2025 NFL holdout by >=2% log-loss with the identifiability flag firing on 5-30% of games.

title: DeepHit Time-to-Injury Forecasting
improvement: GSE deploys a DeepHit time-to-injury survival model over nflverse play-by-play, practice participation, and rest/travel features, producing a per-player-week soft-tissue injury risk score that feeds the injury-report and prop-pricing models.
gate: ADOPT iff DeepHit's chronological-holdout C-index >= 0.70 AND beats the Cox baseline by >= 0.03, with leave-one-team-out IQR <= 0.15.

title: Manipulation in Prediction Markets: An Agent-based Modeling Experiment
improvement: GSE adds a whale-distortion detector that estimates implied whale capital share behind each significant line move and a fade-the-whale paper signal that takes the opposite side of flagged manipulation moves.
gate: ADAPT the detector if whale-flagged line moves reverse at a rate >=10 points higher than size-matched unflagged moves over a full season AND the fade-the-whale paper portfolio is profitable after vig.

title: Leveraging Data to Say No: Memory Augmented Plug-and-Play Selective Prediction
improvement: GSE layers a memory-augmented abstention gate over pick posting: at prediction time it retrieves the k nearest historical game-states, corrects model confidence by neighbor accuracy, and skips or down-stakes low-corrected-confidence games.
gate: ADOPT if on 2024 the memory-augmented abstention policy yields higher ROI at matched coverage than raw-confidence abstention, with AURC reduced by >=10% relative.

title: StreamShield: A Production-Proven Resiliency Solution for Apache Flink at ByteDance
improvement: GSE's data platform adopts a StreamShield-style release pipeline: chaos tests (corrupted partitions, killed builds, deleted log entries) with ACID rollback verified via time travel, plus a probe task that recomputes a pinned week each week — infra honesty plumbing.
gate: ADOPT iff all three chaos tests pass with recovery < 1 build cycle, the probe task runs green for 4 consecutive weeks post-adoption, and no serving incident is traceable to a pipeline change the following quarter.

title: Decision-oriented benchmarking to transform AI weather forecast access: Application to the Indian monsoon
improvement: GSE benchmarks its weather vendors on decision-relevant events (wind > 15 mph, precipitation, extreme wind chill/heat) by miss rate and false alarm rate rather than temperature RMSE, blending vendors with inverse-FAR weights.
gate: ADOPT the blended vendor feed if it reduces game-day weather-event FAR by >= 20% vs the current single feed with no MR increase on the 2024 holdout season.

title: Bounded-Abstention Multi-horizon Time-series Forecasting
improvement: GSE posts its weekly picks as a bounded-abstention system: a calibrated coverage quantile over engine edge scores hits the target posting fraction exactly, so selective ROI is achieved by construction rather than ad-hoc thresholds.
gate: ADAPT iff realized posting coverage lands within 0.05 of target c across >=3 consecutive weeks AND selective ROI at that coverage is >= the fixed-threshold baseline.

title: DISCOVER: A Physics-Informed, GPU-Accelerated Symbolic Regression Framework
improvement: GSE's symbolic regression pipeline gets a sports unit registry (probability/points/EPA/yards/time) that prunes unit-invalid candidate features before the search, cutting search cost without losing historically successful features.
gate: ADAPT if the unit filter prunes >= 40% of generated candidates pre-search AND zero historically selected features are pruned AND validation Brier stays within 1% of the unconstrained run.

title: Neural Sabermetrics World Model
improvement: GSE prototypes a small structured world model (tens of millions of params, not billions) over a compact NFL event vocabulary, used as a sequence-aware feature learner for next-play predictions after a tokenization ablation.
gate: ADOPT the paradigm only if it beats the logistic baseline by >= 0.02 log-loss on the held-out window, ECE <= 0.03 on next-play-type probabilities, and the sequence history (not just current game state) carries the gain.

title: Kelly Betting as Bayesian Model Evaluation: A Framework for Time-Updating Probabilistic Forecasts
improvement: GSE ranks its live-WP candidate models in a Kelly tournament: each model's notional bankroll bets its Kelly fraction against de-vigged live lines, promoting challengers that dominate by log-bankroll growth on rolling 4-week windows.
gate: ADOPT if on the 2024 replay the Kelly tournament identifies the best-calibrated model (by end-of-season log loss) within the first 6 weeks in >=70% of bootstrap replications, beating Brier-based selection.

title: Integrating Unsupervised and Supervised Learning for Defensive Scheme Prediction
