improvement: GSE serves pre-snap man/zone coverage probabilities per play from an HMM fitted on tracking data, decoding motion-driven defensive structure as features for the matchup model.
gate: ADAPT if adding HMM features improves cross-fitted logloss over the pre-motion baseline by >=0.01 with the improvement's 95% interval excluding zero, AND the GCM omnibus test rejects at p < 0.01.

title: Regularized Ensemble Forecasting for Learning Weights from Historical and Current Forecasts
improvement: GSE replaces simple-mean ensemble weights with regularized ensemble forecasting: CCR-prior weights blended from six Identity-L2/Log-Entropy specs with lambda tuned by rolling validation, plus a Bayesian posterior predictive interval on every published forecast.
gate: ADOPT if on the 2024 holdout REF improves margin RMSE >=2% and ATS Brier >=1% vs Simple Mean AND the medium-PS balanced-regime weeks drive the gain; REJECT if REF is within 0.5% of Simple Mean or lambda collapses to a degenerate value.

title: Data-driven modelling of low-dimensional dynamical structures underlying complex full-body human movement
improvement: GSE gains a latent-ODE trajectory predictor on NGS tracking: from ~0.5s of a play it forecasts ball-carrier and defender trajectories through a low-dim latent dynamics model with play-context conditioning.
gate: Adopt if on held-out NFL tracking plays the latent-ODE reduces ball-carrier trajectory RMSE by >=15% vs constant-velocity extrapolation AND a model trained on RBs retains >=70% of its within-RB improvement when applied to WRs.

title: Explainable Machine-Learning based Detection of Knee Injuries in Runners
improvement: GSE ships a soft-tissue injury screening pipeline: a hybrid CNN over NGS stride-kinematic time series with SHAP/Grad-CAM explainability produces a per-player-week hamstring/groin risk score for the injury-report models, validated under strict player-separated CV.
gate: Accepted: the portable pipeline (hybrid temporal CNN + triple-method explainability + honest player-separated validation) maps onto GSE soft-tissue screening despite the original paper's modest accuracies.

title: AlphaPROBE: Alpha Mining via Principled Retrieval and On-graph Biased Evolution
improvement: GSE replaces its flat signal list with a signal DAG (version nodes, derivation edges, retired signals retained) mined by a Bayesian retriever scoring candidates on quality x novelty x exploration, with two subgraphs cross-pollinating market vs team-strength signals.
gate: ADAPT->build if DAG mining yields >=20% more test-significant signals per 100 LLM calls than flat-pool mining AND mean pairwise |corr| <= 0.6 AND no test-season RankIC sign flips.

title: FactorMiner: A Self-Evolving Agent with Skills and Experience Memory for Financial Alpha Discovery
improvement: GSE packages its mining pipeline as an invocable skill with a persistent experience memory (successful templates + forbidden high-correlation families) that directs the LLM generator to fill gaps in the signal zoo rather than re-mine known families.
gate: ADAPT->build if Ralph-Loop mining keeps avg |rho| <= 0.35 as the zoo grows past 100 signals while session-independent mining's |rho| rises above 0.5, with test RankIC at parity or better.

title: Leicester's Tale: Another Perspective on the EPL 2015/16 Through Expected Goals (xG) Modelling
improvement: GSE builds an underlying-performance season simulator that prices playoff probability from early-season EPA-rate strengths with shrinkage toward market-implied priors, replacing flat-preseason-Elo postseason forecasts.
gate: Adopt if on 2020-2025 weeks-1-8 inputs the simulator's P(playoff) Brier score beats the flat-preseason-Elo baseline by >=5% relative improvement in at least 4 of 6 seasons, with no season worse than baseline.

title: Experimental Assortments for Choice Estimation and Nest Identification
improvement: GSE uses binary-assortment experiment designs to detect substitution between DFS contest types (entry-share shifts when contest menus change) and to A/B test X content variants efficiently, avoiding the trap of mistaking correlated variants for independent ones.
gate: ADAPT if the synthetic replication matches the paper's best-at-all-data-sizes claim directionally (mean Rand index >= Benson-et-al.-2016 baseline + 0.05) before any GSE-data application.

title: The Impact of Formations on Football Matches Using Double Machine Learning
improvement: GSE ports three-stage double machine learning to causal NFL game-plan questions (personnel groupings, coverage shells, 4th-down go decisions) with XGBoost nuisance models, cross-fitting by season, and mandatory placebo refutation checks.
gate: ADAPT the DML harness if the placebo test passes (|beta_hat_placebo| < 0.2*|beta_hat_real|) AND estimates are stable across two nuisance learners with sign agreement on all significant effects.

title: Quantifying the Limits of Human Athletic Performance: A Bayesian Analysis of Elite Decathletes
improvement: GSE adds a weather-covariate layer to its player-performance model: per-game-phase posterior weather coefficients (wind/temp/precip/dome) fit in a Bayesian compositional framework, so totals and props price phase-specific weather effects.
gate: ADOPT if tail-CV RMSE improves >=2% over the no-weather baseline, posterior predictive 90% intervals achieve 88-93% empirical coverage, and at least one weather coefficient has a 95% credible interval excluding zero with stable sign across seasons.

title: LAPIS: Lightweight API Specification for Intelligent Systems
improvement: GSE stores LAPIS-style machine-readable API contracts for every sports-data provider (with hand-authored rate-limit sections) and injects them into agent context, cutting context tokens per API task and encoding observed 429s as canonical provider profiles — infra plumbing.
gate: ADAPT if the GSE pilot shows >=70% context-token reduction with first-attempt tool-call accuracy within 5 pp of baseline, and hand-authored limits match observed provider rate limits.

title: Real-time Win Probability and Latent Player Ability via STATS X in Team Sports
improvement: GSE adopts a closed-form Brownian live win-probability model estimated from drive-level cumulative EPA/success-rate stats with a variance-stabilized T-score target, plus an IoF/X-index latent player metric measuring persistent traits.
gate: ADOPT the Brownian closed-form WP if on 2023-2024 its Brier score is <= the nfl4th-grid Brier (within 0.0005) with max decile deviation <0.03; ADOPT the X-index player metric if season X-index has test-retest stability >=0.5 across season halves.

title: Decomposing Crowd Wisdom: Domain-Specific Calibration Dynamics in Prediction Markets
improvement: GSE recalibrates engine probabilities with a per-cell extremizing layer: logistic recalibration fit per (sport x days-to-event x liquidity) cell over engine probabilities and Odds API snapshots, fixing the domain-specific over/under-extremizing that global Platt scaling misses.
gate: ADOPT if on the 2025 NFL held-out season p* beats global Platt scaling by >=0.003 log-loss AND >=10% relative ECE reduction, with per-cell theta estimates statistically distinguishable from 1 (95% CI excluding 1 in >=3 sport x horizon cells).

title: Bayesian Parametric Portfolio Policies
improvement: GSE parameterizes stake sizes as w = theta^T x with a Gaussian prior on theta refit monthly, so early-season stakes are automatically dampened when data are thin — shrinkage-native Kelly sizing.
gate: ADOPT if walk-forward max drawdown improves >=10% vs plain constrained-Kelly sizing with no ROI loss; REJECT if the prior washes out (theta_MAP approx MLE).

title: SymTorch: A Framework for Symbolic Distillation of Deep Neural Networks
improvement: GSE publishes a distilled closed-form 'glass box' equation (<=10 terms via PySR) of its neural win-probability head, linked from every public pick so followers can audit exactly what the model does — trust infrastructure, not alpha.
gate: ADOPT if the distilled equation uses <=10 terms AND matches the neural head within 0.01 MAE on the held-out 2025 Weeks 1-4 window AND beats the linear baseline by >=20% MAE; REJECT on lookahead features or unreadable output.

title: Predicting Tennis Serve Directions with Machine Learning
improvement: GSE prices tennis serve/return props with per-player gradient-boosted serve-direction classifiers trained on grouped-chronological splits and calibrated, reusing the paper's match-charting feature recipes.
gate: ADAPT if grouped-chronological log-loss beats the per-player empirical-frequency baseline by >=5% AND calibration slope on held-out matches is within [0.85, 1.15]; otherwise REJECT the ML layer and use empirical direction frequencies.

title: The Counterfactual Combine: A Causal Framework for Player Evaluation
improvement: GSE evaluates kickers with TMLE causal standardization (direct standardization + above-random-replacement contrasts, 10-fold crossfit, 95% CIs), pricing kicker props and situational edges off the causal rate instead of raw FG%.
gate: ADOPT if the TMLE standardized kicker rate predicts held-out next-season FG% with RMSE >=10% lower than the raw empirical rate on the 2020-2024 -> 2025 window, AND >=80% of kickers' 95% CIs are well-behaved.

title: An Augmented Rating System for Test cricket: adapting the Glicko rating system
improvement: GSE adds a Glicko-style team-strength rater with Brier-grid-search-calibrated logistic scale and margin-of-victory terms as an engine feature complementing EPA metrics.
gate: ADOPT iff on 2023-2024 walk-forward it beats tuned-Elo Brier by >=0.004 absolute with ECE no worse than baseline in every probability bin and bootstrap CV < 2% for all 32 teams.

title: Distributional Regression with Tabular Foundation Models: Evaluating Probabilistic Predictions via Proper Scoring Rules
improvement: GSE trains margin/total models on CRPS-family losses (beta-energy / weighted CRPS) instead of MSE and adds CRPS/IS95 to the model scoreboard, aligning training with the actual distributional use of the forecasts.
gate: ADOPT if the CRPS-trained margin model beats the MSE baseline on held-out 2024 NFL by >=5% relative CRPS improvement AND >=3% IS95 improvement, with at most 2% MAE degradation on the implied point prediction.

title: Cross-Domain Uncertainty Quantification for Selective Prediction: A Comprehensive Bound Ablation with Transfer-Informed Betting
improvement: GSE's pick-certification layer picks risk bounds by calibration-sample size (WSR+LTT for rich markets, empirical Bernstein mid-tier, transfer-informed warm starts for thin markets) so new markets graduate from uncertified to certified with n — honest track-record infrastructure.
gate: ADAPT the bound recipe iff WSR+LTT or LTT+EB certifies >=10% more historical picks than Hoeffding+union at alpha=0.10 with zero forward violations; ADAPT TIB iff it makes >=1 thin market (n<120) certifiable with forward risk <= alpha.

title: The Confidence Gate Theorem: When Should Ranked Decision Systems Abstain?
improvement: GSE gates every abstention policy with the C1/C2 confidence-gate check: the candidate score must positively correlate with realized accuracy with zero bin-wise accuracy inversions, plus an automatic kill rule on any 4-week inversion.
gate: ADOPT if the C1/C2 check passes on held-out data for at least one signal class with zero inversions and the resulting gate lifts held-out hit rate at 80% coverage.

title: NCAA Bracket Prediction Using Machine Learning and Combinatorial Fusion Analysis
improvement: GSE experiments with rank-space ensemble fusion: convert per-game win probabilities to ranks and fuse via rank combination with RSC diversity weights, competing against production score-averaging on existing model outputs.
gate: ADAPT conditional on the paper's reproducibility checks; import only the rank-space fusion operator and RSC diversity-weight idea, rejecting the 74.60% headline as evidence.

title: A Model-Based Restricted Shapley Value to Measure the Players' Contribution to Shot Actions in Football
improvement: GSE attributes drive EPA to individual players via restricted-support Shapley values (model-based worth function, observed participation coalitions, bootstrap SEs, studentized contributions), starting with rushing plays.
gate: ADAPT only if bootstrap PRSV rankings are stable on NFL data; import only the attribution recipe (restricted support + model-based worth + bootstrap SE + studentization).

title: Dynamic Bayesian regression quantile synthesis for forecasting outlook-at-risk
improvement: GSE-QSynth synthesizes agent quantile curves per market with dynamic Bayesian quantile synthesis (random-walk weights, factor structure across same-slate games) via fast sequential filters, refreshing weights in minutes not hours.
gate: ADAPT accepted if walk-forward cumulative CRPS is >=4% lower than the best single agent AND >=2% lower than univariate DRQS-lite, with left-tail CRPS no worse than the best agent and PIT KS distance <= 0.05.

title: Mitigating the Multiplicity Burden: The Role of Calibration in Reducing Predictive Multiplicity of Classifiers
improvement: GSE publishes its daily pick card from a Rashomon ensemble of K near-optimal model variants rather than the single champion, withholding contested picks where the variants disagree (genuinely negative-EV under disagreement).
gate: ADOPT the Rashomon/obscurity layer if on 2024 weeks 9-18 the ensemble card beats the champion-only card by >=1.5% ROI (or >=0.005 Brier improvement) AND contested-pick removal does not reduce total profit; otherwise the champion model stands alone.

title: Single-Event Multinomial Full Kelly via Implicit State Positions
improvement: GSE prices futures and award markets with a multinomial Kelly allocator: greedy support selection over outcomes ranked by model-prob/implied-prob ratio, exact and provably matching brute-force optimal supports.
gate: Gate (pre-GSE): on 1,000 random synthetic markets (M in 4..20) the greedy support must match brute-force optimal support in 100% of cases and the objective value to 1e-9 before any real-money use.

title: ResearchPilot: A Local-First Multi-Agent System for Literature Synthesis and Related Work Drafting
improvement: GSE rebuilds its research pipeline on full-text extraction (method, equations, datasets, results, limitations) into persisted 14-section ledgers with prior-extraction surfacing, replacing the abstract-only design that duplicates research.
gate: ADAPT the architecture, REJECT the abstract-only design. Adopt if the repo runs locally, full-text extraction achieves 100% section/table pointer coverage on a 5-paper pilot, and the persisted corpus demonstrably prevents duplicate research; unverified drafts stay internal until hand-verified.

title: Modeling Matches as Language: A Generative Transformer Approach for Counterfactual Player Valuation in Football
improvement: GSE trains a drive-level transformer over nflverse play-by-play tokens (quantized yard lines, clock, down/distance, teams, starter IDs) as a generative game simulator for free-agency counterfactuals and matchup features.
gate: ADOPT the architecture if on the 2024 test season the transformer beats the Markov baseline on next-play accuracy by >=3 points AND the free-agency simulation MAE is >=15% lower than naive carry-over.

title: FactorEngine: A Program-level Knowledge-Infused Factor Mining Framework for Quantitative Investment
improvement: GSE mines its own research corpus with a multi-agent idea->pseudocode->executable-signal pipeline, seeded from extracted report passages (restricted to pre-cutoff dates), so the signal zoo is seeded by documented methods rather than ad-hoc hand ideas.
gate: ADAPT->build if report-seeded program mining beats hand-seeded mining on test IR by >=25% with no worse drawdown, AND at least 30% of surviving programs trace their core idea to an extracted report passage.

title: NFL step-and-turn: A generative framework for evaluating player movement in American football
improvement: GSE ports the 'Ghost Score' methodology: expected ending yard line vs an average-player ghost at every frame of every RB carry (then RAC receivers), refit on 2022-2025 tracking data as a rushing-efficiency matchup feature.
gate: ADOPT if the refit reproduces the paper's yards-success-rate leaderboard (Spearman >=0.80 vs Table 3 on weeks 1-9 2022) AND shows split-half stability (Spearman >=0.60 between first-half and second-half carry sets).

title: Learning to Bet for Horizon-Aware Anytime-Valid Testing
improvement: GSE screens model-version upgrades with an anytime-valid betting e-process over per-pick scores, so a challenger is promoted the moment it shows a statistically valid edge over breakeven instead of waiting for a fixed-sample test.
gate: Gate (pre-GSE validation): at N=100, alpha=0.05 on the paper's Beta-mixture setting (m=0.45, mu_X=0.40), DQN's deadline rejection probability must exceed empirical Kelly's by >=5 percentage points and match-or-beat the hedge baseline.

title: Simultaneous Estimation of Ballpark Effects and Team Defense Using Total Bases Residuals
improvement: GSE builds a 'Stadium Factor' index via joint WLS estimation of venue effects and team unit effects on expected-points residuals, with honest uncertainty intervals and an external home-away validity check.
gate: ADAPT if simultaneous venue/personnel decomposition with honest uncertainty intervals and an external home-away validity check demonstrates first-class methodology GSE can reuse for stadium effects.

title: ParlayMarket: Automated Market Making for Parlay-style Joint Contracts
improvement: GSE prices same-game parlays with an Ising joint model over binarized legs initialized from marginal probabilities, detecting coherent-edge spots where book SGP prices violate Frechet bounds or deviate from coherent joint prices.
gate: Adopt the Ising SGP pricer if on the backtest season: book SGP prices violate Frechet bounds or deviate from coherent joint prices at a rate comparable to the paper's Kalshi findings, the coherent-edge rule is profitable after a realistic fee/spread haircut with positive Sharpe, and joint-probability calibration passes a Hosmer-Lemeshow-style check.

title: Chain-Reaction Causal Discovery via Blocking Interventions
improvement: GSE runs a do(X=0) engine sandbox: the pipeline executes on frozen historical slates with one feature/source blocked at a time, recovering the true dependency DAG (which downstream outputs change) and identifying zero-effect features as pruning candidates.
gate: ADOPT the sandbox protocol if it recovers all 5 known dependencies with no false negatives AND identifies >=3 features with zero downstream effect; REJECT the tree assumption and allow multi-parent DAG structure.

title: STAMP: A shot-type-aware areal multilevel Poisson model for league-wide comparison of basketball shot charts
improvement: GSE wires areal-Poisson offensive tendency maps (team x field-zone relative rates from a hierarchical model over nflverse play-by-play) into matchup features, replacing raw empirical tendency tables.
gate: ADOPT if the full hierarchical model beats the fixed-effects baseline by Delta-elpd >= 500 nats on the holdout AND team x zone relative-rate estimates are stable across the two test windows (Spearman >=0.7).
